concerns.text: The evaluation metric (BLEU/semantic similarity) compares generated trajectories to the *unselected rationales*, which are also the source of the teacher distribution used during training (FR‑003). Because the model is trained to match the averaged logits of those same rationales, the BLEU/diversity scores are not independent of the predictor; they may trivially improve as a direct consequence of the training target, creating a circular validation of the AntiSD effect.
